_comment: Map area_id -> sub-region display name, keyed by dune.actors.map. Extracted from the game client paks (BP_FogOfWarAreaDefineSpline_C actors in Maps/Arrakis/SOC_1/SubLevels/Survival_1_AreaDefinedSplines: m_AreaId.m_Id -> m_AreaName). The area_id space matches dune.markers.area_id, so a vehicle is labelled by the nearest marker's area.
